'''Kalen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] and the [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea sector]]. He was a family friend of the [[Mothma family/Legends|Mothma family]] and employed a young [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] as a personal assistant, who provided the elderly Senator Kalen with invaluable service.<ref name="FF82">{{FactFile2014|82|MOT 1-4|Mon Mothma}}</ref> On his first visit to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Kalen was late for a session in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. He decided to take an [[Air taxi/Legends|air taxi]] and offered the driver 100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] if he would drive as fast as possible to reach the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] in half the time. The driver succeeded and made it just in time, but Senator Kalen died on the way from a heart attack caused by the assertive driving.

Upon Kalen's sudden death, Mon Mothma was swiftly nominated and elected as his successor in the Senate in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]. At nineteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of age, Mon Mothma became the youngest [[Human/Legends|Human]] senator of the Republic's history and later fought for [[Democracy/Legends|democracy]] as the leader of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order|fall of the Republic]].<ref name="FF82" />

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' author, [[Iain Lowson]] wrote details about Kalen within the ''Fact File''.<ref name="Blogspot">{{Blogspot|subdomain=embraagain|url=2013/04/taxi-little-star-wars-story.html|name=Embra, again.|text=TAXI!
